facts.author: Nik Koios
facts.headline: Heathrow's Third Runway: A £62.5bn Miscalculation in a Shrinking World
facts.summary: Government analysis reveals Heathrow's third runway offers only a 0.05% GDP boost, a 90% drop from prior estimates, while risking £62.5bn in trade-offs. This miscalculation ignores how climate volatility and the de-dollarization of commodity trade are reshaping global logistics networks. The UK faces a future where massive infrastructure projects fail to deliver growth in a fracturing system.
